name: Group Quest Tutorial
description: Learn about collaborative gameplay, raids, trading, and tokenized assets

steps.title: Quest Assigned - Prepare for Raid!
steps.description: Excellent! You're now signed up for a group activity. To participate in the upcoming raid, you'll need to purchase a Raid Access Ticket from the Foundry. This covers raid operational costs.

steps.title: Go to Foundry > NFT
steps.description: Navigate to the Foundry and select the "NFT" tab to browse available access tickets. You'll need to purchase a Raid Access Ticket to participate in the upcoming raid.

steps.title: Purchase Raid Access Ticket
steps.description: Find the Raid Access Ticket and purchase it. Use the left sidebar to navigate to Access tickets.

steps.title: Check Tavern Events
steps.description: Now that you have your ticket, head to the Tavern and check the Events section to see when the next raid is scheduled. Look for "Raiding The Suns of Tufa"!

steps.title: Sign Up for the Raid
steps.description: Perfect! You can see the "Raiding The Suns of Tufa" event. Click the Sign Up button to join the raid using your Raid Access Ticket.

steps.title: Raid Complete - Loot Received!
steps.description: Congratulations! The raid was a success! You've received your share of the loot: 2,500 Frameworks and 500 Electromagnets. Now let's trade these for Chi ship parts!

steps.title: Go to Armory > Shop (G2P)
steps.description: Navigate to the Armory and select the "Shop" tab to access the Guild-to-Player marketplace.

steps.title: Trade Frameworks for Chi Parts
steps.description: Find the buy order where the guild is purchasing Frameworks in exchange for Chi parts. Trade 500 Frameworks to receive 1 Chi part.

steps.title: Trade Electromagnets for Chi Parts
steps.description: Now trade your Electromagnets! Find the buy order for Electromagnets. Trade 100 Electromagnets to receive 1 Chi part.

steps.title: Go to Foundry > Custom > Tokenised
steps.description: Navigate to the Foundry, select "Custom", then "Tokenised" to redeem your parts for a complete Chi ship!

steps.title: Redeem Chi Parts for Chi Ship
steps.description: Find the Rainbow Chi redemption option and exchange your 150 Chi parts for 1 complete Rainbow Chi ship! Enter 1 in the amount field and click Redeem.

steps.title: Return to Quest Board
steps.description: Now return to the Quest Board > Group Quests to deliver your completed quest and claim your final rewards.
steps.action: Navigate to Quest Board > Group Quests

steps.title: Deliver Completed Quest
steps.description: Find your Tutorial Group Activity quest and click "Deliver" to submit your completed mission. You've successfully demonstrated group collaboration, raid participation, resource trading, and asset redemption!

steps.title: Thank You for Exploring dGuild!
steps.description:
Congratulations! You've completed all tutorial paths and experienced the core features of dGuild. This is concept art - a vision of what we're working toward. We provide the foundation, but you build your story.

Feel free to explore more of the platform. The future of guild management is collaborative, decentralized, and community-driven. Thank you for your time!

Join our Discord or follow us on X to stay updated!
